calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

Affected areas and owners:
- food-safety: Additives, dyes, labeling, food safety → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
- sourcing: Ingredients from farms, pesticide limits, crop rules → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
- sales: Retail channels, SNAP, pricing → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
- operations: Plant safety, labor, trucking fleet → Ben Kowalski (Operations)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-30 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if it is a rule or proposed rule with a deadline less than 90 days after 2026-10-30, or a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-10-30; otherwise High for final rules, Medium for proposed rules and for notices with a deadline, Low for anything else), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.

I found two Federal Register documents from 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-30 that plausibly affect Brightside. My search budget ran out before I could open every document or browse every day's issue, so the list may be incomplete. The first item, the DMSO tolerance rule, is only partly checked.

## Items found

**1. 2026-22176: Dimethyl Sulfoxide; Pesticide Tolerances**
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22176
- **Type and date:** EPA rule in the "Pesticide Tolerance; Exemptions, Petitions, Revocations" category, published 2026-10-30 (pages 68480–68484).
- **Key deadline:** I did not open the document. EPA tolerance rules usually take effect on publication, so I am assuming an effective date of 2026-10-30. Please confirm.
- **Tier:** Critical, because it is a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-10-30. This holds only if the effective date is 10/30.
- **Owner:** sourcing (Tom Alvarez)
- **Reason:** It is an EPA change to pesticide residue tolerances. It may cover crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn), but I haven't verified which commodities it names.
- **Action:** Read the commodity table and effective date. Check whether our pecan, apple and corn growers use DMSO-containing products. Tell our suppliers if so.

**2. 2026-21913: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Color Additive Certification**
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/28/2026-21913/agency-information-collection-activities-submission-for-office-of-management-and-budget-review
- **Type and date:** FDA notice, published 2026-10-28.
- **Key deadline:** Not stated in the text I retrieved. Comments go to OMB under control number 0910-0216. OMB submission notices typically allow 30 days, which would be about 2026-11-27. Please confirm.
- **Tier:** Low, because I could not confirm a deadline. It would be Medium if one is confirmed.
- **Owner:** food-safety (Maria Chen)
- **Reason:** It renews the batch-certification program for color additives. Color additive manufacturers submit a request for certification with a sample of each batch. Brightside doesn't file this itself, but we buy certified dyes for our gummies and casings.
- **Action:** Note that the program is continuing. Ask our dye suppliers whether certification fees or timing will change.

## Reviewed but not included
- **Other FDA notices on 10/28:** The Rapid Response Surveys notice (2026-21912, comments due 2026-12-28), the Electronic Records/Signatures notice and the fellowship-program notice. They are generic FDA information collections with no clear effect on us.
- **FMCSA exemption notices on 10/26 and 10/27:** These are exemption requests from other carriers (steady-burning lamps rule, commercial learner's permit holders). They don't change our fleet's obligations.
- **OSHA permanent variance on 10/29:** It covers a tunnel project's compressed-air work, so it doesn't apply to us.
- **USDA information-collection notices on 10/28:** Livestock mandatory reporting, organic enforcement and farm records are not about our crops or products.
- **Documents published just outside the window:**
  - The FDA infant formula proposed rule (announced 10/29, published 11/02).
  - The SNAP categorical eligibility proposed rule (11/10).
  - The pecan marketing order proposed rule (11/09).
- **FSIS Notice 43-26:** It covers sampling in plants making post-lethality-exposed ready-to-eat products, which includes hot dogs. It appeared in an AFDO roundup, not as a Federal Register document. Maria Chen may want to read it anyway.

I found no rules in this window on SNAP, FDA food labeling or additive rules, USDA pecan or apple orders, or OSHA and FMCSA rules.
